description: Source code for OSDP protocol physical layer handling, including packet construction, validation, encryption, and decryption functions.

methods.name: packet_has_mark
methods.description: Checks if the packet has a mark byte set in the PD flags.

methods.name: packet_set_mark
methods.description: Sets or clears the mark byte flag in the PD flags.

methods.name: osdp_compute_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum over a message buffer.

methods.name: osdp_phy_get_seq_number
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally increments the sequence number for the PD.

methods.name: osdp_phy_packet_get_data_offset
methods.description: Calculates data offset within a received packet.

methods.name: osdp_phy_packet_get_smb
methods.description: Retrieves the secure message block from a packet if present.

methods.name: osdp_phy_in_sc_handshake
methods.description: Determines if the packet ID corresponds to a secure channel handshake.

methods.name: osdp_phy_packet_init
methods.description: Initializes a packet buffer with header and control info.

methods.name: osdp_phy_packet_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a packet by adding CRC, MAC, and encryption if needed.

methods.name: osdp_phy_check_packet
methods.description: Validates received packet for correctness, address, sequence, and CRC.

methods.name: osdp_phy_decode_packet
methods.description: Decodes and decrypts a received packet, verifying MAC and integrity.

methods.name: osdp_phy_state_reset
methods.description: Resets the physical layer state of the PD.
